nodes:
b>Trigger
The expert has been asked to specify a product, or has an idea they want built, and has nothing written down.

b>ST-001 Expert states the idea and their domain
Domain expert

b>ST-002 Expert is taught a section, then interviewed on it
Domain expert

b>ST-003 Expert reads the draft and its grade
Domain expert

b>ST-004 Expert answers the one question that improves it most
Domain expert

b>ST-005 Expert sees what a development team could not build
Domain expert

b>ST-006 Sponsor approves the PRD for a release
Sponsor

b>End state
The set is approved, with or without recorded conditions, at a named version, every section has a grade with no blocking defects, every open question has a decider and a date, and the buildability review reports no gap that is neither closed nor owned.
